description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and Pyramid of the Pantheon to become a creature.
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Pyramid of the Pantheon, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Pyramid of the Pantheon
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more brick counters on it
